$schema.description: The JSON Schema this file follows. `contingency config init` pins it to the installed CLI version.

channel.description: Push Claude Code channel events when a session changes. Stdio only.

interface.description: Which tools the server registers: single-tool offers every operation inside agent_code_execute; native registers each tool directly.

port.description: The port `contingency mcp` serves the Workspace and /mcp on. 0 binds any free port. Defaults to 7777 from a terminal and 0 otherwise; `contingency start` and registered agents always pass 0.

videoFastForward.description: How Run videos fast-forward Idle Gaps: capped shortens each gap to a ceiling; fixed plays every gap at one speed.

first.description: Tell the agent to try a System One Pursuit for each Flow Skill step first. Has no effect without a configured endpoint or installed Local System One.

local.description: Automatically use an installed Local System One when no endpoint is configured. Setup is always a user terminal action.

url.description: The System One endpoint: its origin or its full /v1/systemone route. Setting it is consent to send Pursuit requests, and the API key, there. User file only: a project file that sets it fails validation. The API key is environment-only (CONTINGENCY_SYSTEM_ONE_API_KEY).

systemOne.description: System One, which pursues delegated sub-goals.

port.description: The port `contingency web` serves the Workspace on.

publicUrl.description: The URL a browser opens when the Workspace is reached through a proxy or tunnel. Defaults to the bound address.

title: Contingency Settings
description: Contingency Settings. Read from config.json in the Catalog Root and from ~/.contingency/config.json; the environment overrides both.
